# cubepath_managed_database_credentials (Data Source)

Reads the admin connection credentials of an active managed database. Needs an API token with managed_database:write; every read is recorded in the activity log and the API allows 10 reads every 5 minutes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `managed_database_id` (String) UUID of the managed database.

### Read-Only

- `host` (String) Host to connect to.
- `id` (String) The managed database UUID.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Admin password.
- `port` (Number) Port to connect to.
- `uri` (String, Sensitive) Connection URI (mysql://, postgresql:// or redis://) with the credentials.
- `username` (String) Admin username.
